description: She wears an opaque dark-green floor-length court gown with a fitted low square bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold woven knotwork borders frame neckline, front panels, sleeves and skirt edges. A cream underdress shows through the long center opening above dark closed shoes. A matching green shawl lined with cream cloth drapes along her forearms and ends in gold-fringed tassels. Paired round gold-toned brooches mark the bodice shoulders; a decorated woven belt, small circular-disc necklace and narrow bracelet add restrained ornament. The textured green cloth appears wool-like, with linen-like pale layers; exact fibers are uncertain.
